insurer: Universal Sompo General Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Policy covers room, boarding and nursing expenses but no explicit room rent cap or category is mentioned in the wording.

icu.note: ICU charges are defined and covered but no explicit cap or sub-limit is stated.

copayment.note: A co-payment of 20% applies on each and every claim for insured persons above 55 years of age.

sub_limits.display: Package charges capped at 75% of SI; maternity up to 5% of SI
sub_limits.note: Hospitalisation under agreed package charges restricted to 75% of SI; maternity/newborn treatment up to 5% of SI; no other explicit disease-wise sub-limits stated.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases excluded for 36 months from first policy inception; portability credits applicable.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, piles, arthritis, joint replacement, stones, etc.) excluded for 12 months.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses covered after 9 months from policy inception; newborn treatment up to 5% of SI; ectopic pregnancy covered; miscarriage due to accident covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative bonus is defined in the policy but no rate or maximum percentage is stated in the wording.

restoration.note: No restoration or reinstatement benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Medical expenses incurred in the 30 days immediately prior to hospitalisation are covered.

post_hosp.note: Medical expenses incurred in the 60 days immediately after discharge are covered.

day_care.note: Specific day-care procedures listed (dialysis, chemotherapy, radiotherapy, eye surgery, lithotripsy, D&C, tonsillectomy) plus technologically advanced procedures requiring less than 24 hours.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered when patient cannot be moved to hospital or no room is available.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment and AYUSH hospitals are defined and included within the policy scope.

organ_donor.note: Cost of organ harvesting is explicitly listed as a covered medical expense.

ambulance.note: Ambulance charges limited to ₹1,000 per policy period for admissible claims.

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery and other modern/advanced treatments are not explicitly mentioned or listed.

consumables.note: Annexure A lists a large number of consumables/non-medical items explicitly excluded (gloves, masks, nebuliser kits, etc.).

global_cover.note: Specific exclusion: treatment taken outside the geographical limits of India is excluded.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim can be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 15 days grace for monthly premium mode; 30 days for quarterly/half-yearly/annual modes.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document for policies of one year or more.

portability.note: Portability permitted as per IRDAI norms; credits for PED waiting, specific waiting periods and moratorium transferable.

notable_exclusions.display: Treatment outside India, large consumables list (gloves/masks/nebulisers), adventure sports injuries, infertility/IVF, gender change

optional_riders.display: Personal Accident Death Cover (optional add-on for account holder, spouse, children)
